comments.body: There is sumting wrong with the bird. i can't see it on my phone when i open the program tough you can tell it is there

comments.body: I’m trying to play it on my phone and the bird is invisible, I see only the game level/environment and keep dying because I can’t see the bird

comments.author: Embarrassed_Hawk_655
comments.body: Huh. Imagine if somebody made something NEW with or without AI. That’d be something.

replies.author: AdmirableJudgment784
replies.body: What do you mean NEW? Flappy bird wasn't new in the sense that it's derived from Super Mario. Like completely new or are you talking about gameplay mechanics?
